guards: Remote channel watchdog detects missing managed process and relaunches existing launcher.
Universal MCP health failure invokes existing ensure script; no second server.
Command Center health failure invokes existing deployment/recovery path only when lease gate permits.
C5 failure remains fail-closed and restores only an approved canonical source.
Stale provider/device IDs never replace RAIOS_HOST_AG.
Repeated failure produces evidence and stops rather than creating parallel infrastructure.
escalation: C1 on ownership, governance, destructive or unresolved canonical conflict
